# Expression

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Evaluate a JavaScript expression to compute a single value. Available variables: `data` (all input data), `d` (first element), `op()` (access other operators), `sequenceTime` (timeline position), `frame` (current frame), `totalFrames`, `sequence` (timeline metadata). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/expression",
  "type": "ExpressionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/expression').par.data` (an input) and `op('/expression').out.data` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.data`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `ListField` | `[]` |
| `expression` | `ExpressionField` | `""` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
